runtimesToPersist.description: Runtime for which interpreters in this thread pool should be persisted.

onInterpreterStart.description:
This lambda is called within a Python interpreter immediately after the interpreter is created, allowing you to
initialize the interpreter. This Lambda should accept no arguments, and return no value. To specify which which
interpreters should run this lambda on interpreter start, you must set an `actionRequirement` on the lambda.
This lambda will only be called for interpreters whose {@link Action.Engine#canRun action engine can run} this
{@link Lambda#actionRequirement lambda's action requirement}. If no `actionRequirement` is set on this lambda,
this lambda will be ran for all Python interpreters; this is likely not desirable.

Example: suppose I have the following c3 type declaration and want to call the method when the interpreter gets
started to load an LLM model into memory:
```
type LLMLoaderType {
   loadModel: function() py-my-runtime
}
```
it is only desirable and meaningful to call this method in interpreters for runtime `py-my-runtime`. Therefore,
I would set the `actionRequirement` field on my `onInterpreterStart` `Lambda` to be `py-my-runtime`. This ensures
`loadModel` is only called on the start of interpreters for the `py-my-runtime` runtime.
An example to create the py config:
```js
  let py_simple_config = App.Node.ThreadPool.Config.Py.Simple.builder()
     .onInterpreterStart(Lambda.fromPySrc("lambda: LLMLoaderType.loadModel()", "py-my-runtime"))
     ... // other configurations
  ).build();
```

Note: please always choose the appropriate action requirement and specify it when setting this lambda, otherwise
there could potentially be unexpected initialization behavior.

initializeEagerly.description:
If true, persisted interpreters are initialized when the thread is created. If false, persisted interpreters are
initialized just before being used the first time.

Initialization means that the interpreter is started, the Python SDK is bootstrapped,
and the {@link #onInterpreterStart} lambda is invoked (if applicable).

title:
A "simple" Python interpreter configuration. This configuration specifies Python interpreter management
configurations which apply to all threads in the thread pool. Threads can be configured to:
 - persist a set of runtimes for Python interpreters
 - invoke a lambda on interpreter start (enabling interpreter initialization)
 - initialize interpreters lazily (when needed) or eagerly (on thread start)
name: App.Node.ThreadPool.Config.Py.Simple
